answer: A concrete sybil brake is a single-occupancy bridge. Each operator may register one ivory hardware root, and only that root may enter the reward set in an epoch. An oasis of five non-kin checkers re-derives the root quote from a public challenge before the crossing counts. A second alias must buy a new root and lock a bond equal to two epochs of rewards, burned if the quotes collide. Each fake head therefore costs a device plus a double-epoch stake, with no shared crossing.
